name: Dragon
description: The dragon curve's fold rule, read off the bits of the cell index.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 100%); @match(@i & 1 == 1) { -webkit-transform: rotate(90deg); transform: rotate(90deg); } @match(@i & 2 == 2) { -webkit-transform: rotate(180deg); transform: rotate(180deg); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
